verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke documents an employment-and-pensions practice. Its EC&VC team brings in 'employment' and IP specialists to support businesses 'from incorporation through to exit', and it advises on employee incentives such as EMI and share options. That implies, but never states, help with hiring documentation. The tribunal pricing page covers dismissal litigation, not hiring paperwork. Missing for 10: any explicit mention of drafting offer letters, employment agreements or invention-assignment/confidentiality agreements, any described hiring-documentation service, and independent corroboration.
